purpose: A PWL source reading a file that does not exist is refused, not run as DC 0.

oracle.derivation: nonexist.txt does not exist beside the deck, so no reading of `pwl file=nonexist.txt` can produce the waveform: the source has no value and the deck fails. Xyce 7.10.0 exits 1 (netlist error at line 2); ngspice-44.2 and 45 exit 1 (fatal error).

confirmed.result: ngspice exit 1: ERROR: fatal error in ngspice, exit(1); Xyce exit 1: Netlist error in file d.sp at or near line 2 / Simulation aborted due to error.  There are 0 MSG_FATAL errors and 1 MSG_ERROR
